Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
I had asked before, if Action Mods and Reactions could
be played during a Blood Hunt action, and LSJ said "No",
and even pointed out the rules.

But, can they be used during other cardless votes (i.e.
burning the Elysium)?

If not, why does Telepathic Vote counting say, "If you
played a political card to call this vote..", if that's
the only way to play the card anyway?

Messages.Author: Hardy Range
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> schrieb im Newsbeitrag

I think you still are confused concerning the Blood Hunt...
Calling a Blood Hunt in response to a diablerie is NOT an action - a
Methuselah is calling that vote, not one of her minions. That is the reason
action modifiers and reaction cards cannot be used during the referendum,
nor other cards that say "during a political action".

The vote to burn the Elysium (and similar effects from a lot of other cards)
are political actions by card text, so yes, you can use action modifiers or
reaction cards.

--

Hardy Range

hardy...@gmx.de

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> I had asked before, if Action Mods and Reactions could
> be played during a Blood Hunt action, and LSJ said "No",
> and even pointed out the rules.
>
> But, can they be used during other cardless votes (i.e.
> burning the Elysium)?

Yes.

The difference is that the vote to burn the Elysium is
a political action taken by a vampire.

A blood hunt is not an action; it's called by a Methuselah.
